caveats: Figures are as reported by each nursing home on its Connecticut DSS 'Annual Report of Long-Term Care Facility' for the cost year ending September 30. They are the home's own filing, before DSS audit or rate-setting adjustments, and are not Medicaid-allowable costs.
Figures were read from the published PDFs by software. Scanned reports were read with OCR. Each figure is checked against the totals printed on the same report; figures that fail a check are marked.

Direct care follows the DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and nurse-aide salaries, related fringe benefits, and nursing pool (agency) costs. Fringe benefits are not reported by job, so the direct-care share of fringe is allocated in proportion to nursing salaries.
Owner, officer and related-party names, addresses and amounts are shown as written on the report and in CMS ownership data. Addresses may be business or personal addresses as filed.
Being listed as an owner or related party is not an allegation of wrongdoing. Spending figures are not a measure of care quality.
